articles.title: Shuttlers launches Pod to offer shared door-to-door rides in Lagos
articles.text:
What most Shuttlers customers probably do not know is that the company’s earliest riders did not walk to a bus stop. When Shuttlers launched, it offered a door-to-door service before switching to the bus-stop-to-bus-stop model that Lagos commuters know today.
“We started with ‘doorstep to doorstep’, then moved to ‘bus stop to bus stop’, because it was difficult for us to coordinate without technology,” Damilola Olokesusi, Shuttlers’ co-founder and chief executive, told TechCabal in a video interview on September 9. After a few months, it also became clear the model was not profitable.
Shuttlers changed its pickup model after an angel investor gave the team two buses to test routes. The company restarted with buses running on fixed routes at fixed times, with passengers meeting them at designated stops. That is the Shuttlers model most Lagos commuters know today. The company says it has completed more than 10 million journeys with this model and now operates more than 430 buses daily across Lagos, Abuja and Port Harcourt.
On 25 September, Shuttlers will return to the doorstep with its new product, Shuttlers Pod, a car that picks up to four commuters from their homes, one after the other, and drops each person at their own destination. Riders must book ahead and can either share the car with neighbours heading the same way or pay for the whole car themselves.
“The scheduled part means you have to book in advance,” said Olokesusi. “That is the only way we can offer the service affordably. If it is a new pod, we allocate a vehicle around 24 hours before.”
Riders also “have to pay for at least two trips in a week,” she added, while the fare varies depending on how many people share the vehicle.
Shuttlers announced the product on September 4, two days after Uber shut down its Nigerian business following 12 years in the market. With Uber gone, Shuttlers sees an opening among commuters who pay for private rides in Lagos and now have one fewer option. Olokesusi said Pod is designed to attract customers beyond the commuters who already use Shuttlers’ buses.
But Pod revives two questions that ended the 2015 experiment: can home pickups make money, and can shared car rides work as a business?
“If anything, I think the fundamentals are actually worse than they were in 2022,” said Laolu Onifade, the former CEO of Hytch, a now-defunct carpooling startup. “Inflation has significantly reduced purchasing power, and there is a real ceiling to what consumers are willing or able to pay for transportation.”
Today, Shuttlers pays the fleet companies that supply its vehicles a fixed amount for each trip and takes on the job of filling the seats. On a bus, that promise is spread across 15 or 30 seats. On a Pod, it rests on four. How often Shuttlers can fill those seats will determine whether the model works.
“I wouldn’t say a four-seat fixed-pay model is impossible, but I wouldn’t build the business around the assumption that four seats automatically solve the economics,” said Onifade.
The walk to the bus stop
The first part of the commute is where Shuttlers loses some potential customers, Olokesusi told TechCabal. The company’s data shows that some customers spend 10 to 20 minutes getting to their bus stop, while others miss their buses because their last-mile transport arrives late or they cannot find one.
The problem worsens when Lagos floods.
“Around the flooding period, customers were finding it difficult to get to the bus stop,” she said, adding that many asked Shuttlers for help reaching the stop.
For some commuters, that first stretch determines whether they use Shuttlers at all.
“Getting to the bus stop early in the morning is a challenge that prevents some people from using Shuttlers,” Olokesusi said. “They either drive or use ride-hailing.”
Pod is built with those commuters in mind. “Picking them up from their doorstep gets us closer to those customers,” she said.
The beginning of Pods
When TechCabal spoke to Olokesusi on September 9, a week after Uber’s exit, one obvious question was whether Shuttlers had accelerated Pod because Uber was leaving.
“Honestly, it was almost as though we were sensing it,” she said.
Since the start of 2026, Olokesusi said, Shuttlers has been looking for ways to win customers beyond its existing base. The company has several products “sitting on the shelf,” including a Shuttlers for schools.
It tested the shared school service before shelving it after working through the unit economics. The company concluded that the market was not ready for the way it had designed the service, although it already runs a private school transport service. That turned the team’s attention to Pod, an idea it had been considering for about two years. The chief technology officer built the prototype himself, and staff began testing it.
Then Uber announced its exit. “When we saw the exit, we knew it was the time for us to launch Shuttlers Pod,” she said. When Shuttlers announced Pod, it was with a waitlist and three weeks away from the first ride.
How Pod works
To ride a Pod, you open the Shuttlers app, choose Pod, and enter your home address and destination. Shuttlers has divided Lagos into clusters and will open Pods one cluster at a time. If your area is covered, the app shows a list of departure times: 6:30 a.m., 7 a.m., 8 a.m., 9:30 a.m.
Say you pick 6:30 a.m. before anyone else has; the app tells you the pod is not live yet. It fills as a second, third, and fourth rider from your area books the same slot. “We cannot run a one-person pod on a four-person vehicle,” Olokesusi said. What you pay depends on how many people end up in it.
You can speed that up. Every booking comes with a link you can drop into a WhatsApp group to pull friends into your pod, but Shuttlers will not match you with someone who lives far away, even if you work in the same place. “If you live in VGC and the available vehicle is on a Chevron pod, we will not match you,” she said, naming two areas on the Lekki-Epe Expressway.
A group pod needs at least three riders to run. If you would rather not wait, book a solo pod and pay for every seat. Either way, you must commit to at least two trips a week. Once a pod forms, Shuttlers assigns a driver and car about 24 hours before the first trip, and on the morning itself, you get a notice 30 minutes before pickup, telling you the car has left its first stop. The app plans the route between the homes to keep the trip short.
Pod is starting in Lagos only. Victoria Island is among the first areas, alongside mainland routes Olokesusi did not name. Over 1,000 people had joined the waitlist when we spoke, and their requests had already surfaced on the 10 most popular routes. Shuttlers is pairing that with its own data on where young professionals live.
“If riders do not book in advance, they cannot get it cheaper,” she said.
Can Pod succeed where other carpooling products failed?
Home pickups are only one half of Pod. The other is getting people to share a car with strangers, a model that several Nigerian mobility startups have struggled to make work.
In 2023, Shuttlers expanded its fleet to meet demand for carpooling and recruited private cars into its network. It was entering the market where Hytch, Ridebliss, and GoMyWay had previously struggled to build a sustainable carpooling business.
Hytch eventually abandoned carpooling for logistics and later shut down, while GoMyWay also closed after struggling to raise more funding.
“We tried it. It did not work,” Olokesusi said.
A problem with traditional carpooling is the incentive for the driver.
A private car owner offers spare seats in a vehicle they already own. They are already making the trip, so the extra money from passengers is often a bonus rather than the reason for making the journey.
“The driver’s incentive might be to make friends or to offset fuel costs,” she said. Riders and drivers meet on the carpooling app, eventually swap numbers, and arrange the next trip without the app. “Carpooling like that is people matchmaking each other and then cutting the platform out of the deal,” she said. “It is a very nice social experiment in this part of the world, but it does not make money.”
Another problem is the car itself because a platform like Shuttlers cannot tell a private owner how to maintain their vehicle. “You can wake up one day, and the person you are riding with has biscuit crumbs in the car because their children have been eating in it,” she said. A carpool also depends on one person’s plans. If the rider has a stomach ache and stays home, nobody in the carpool gets a ride that day.
Shuttlers already run cars on its stop-to-stop model, carrying three or four passengers between bus stops at a slightly higher fare than the bus. Pod moves the pickup to the front door.
Olokesusi said Pod can clear those hurdles because the technology Shuttlers lacked in 2015, when it first ran a door-to-door product, now exists. Software, including AI, can group riders by address, she said, and picking up four neighbours is simpler than getting 20-plus people onto a bus inside a two-minute window. “We have done the harder part,” she said.
Pod’s answer to the carpooling supply problem is the model Shuttlers already runs for its buses. The startup does not plan to own Pod vehicles and will rely on fleet operators, as it currently does with the 160 fleet operators that supply more than 400 vehicles to the bus platform, and those operators employ the drivers.
An operator is a business with vehicle financing and other bills to pay. It needs the work every day, which gives Shuttlers the leverage to enforce rules on how cars are kept and how drivers are treated. To keep operators loyal, Shuttlers pays them before the seats are sold.
“With the Shuttlers model, we guarantee scheduled rides, and we guarantee our operators’ revenue,” she said. “When they come to do a trip on our platform, we have an agreement, and we pay a fixed amount.” If a rival tries to poach a driver, she said, the driver will ask whether that rival can pay in advance and guarantee work whether or not there are trips.
In 2023, Olokesusi told TechCabal that what a driver earns on a trip depends on the vehicle and is agreed upon onboarding, and that Shuttlers makes sure the seats are filled. If the operator’s pay per trip is fixed, every empty seat is Shuttlers’ cost. The size of the vehicle decides how much that hurts. On a 30-seat bus, one empty seat is about 3% of the seats on the trip. On a 15-seat bus, it is about 7%. On a four-seat Pod, it is 25%.
The price test
Olokesusi estimated that a Pod seat on one route would cost between ₦4,000 and ₦4,500 ($3.02 to $3.40).
If three passengers share the vehicle, the trip would generate between ₦12,000 and ₦13,500 ($9.07 to $10.21) in passenger revenue before Shuttlers pays the operator and accounts for its own costs. If four riders each pay that, the car takes in ₦16,000 to ₦18,000 ($12.10 to $13.61) for the trip.
That is roughly comparable to the ₦10,000 to ₦15,000 ($7.56 to $11.34) that a single ride-hailing trip on the same route might cost, based on Olokesusi’s estimate.
“The challenge is that you have to price each seat low enough to compete with Bolt and other alternatives, but high enough for the operator and platform to make money,” said Onifade. “That’s a very difficult middle ground. I wouldn’t say a four-seat fixed-pay model is impossible, but I wouldn’t build the business around the assumption that four seats automatically solve the economics.”
For Pods, passengers split the cost of a car, while Shuttlers tries to keep the vehicle sufficiently occupied to make the economics work. But the company still has to pay the operator’s fixed fee and retain a margin. The fee also has to compete with what the same vehicle could earn elsewhere.
One driver told TechCabal this month that an hour driving on Bolt or inDrive could generate between ₦12,500 and ₦13,000 ($9.45 to $9.83). A Pod trip involving multiple pickups in Lagos morning traffic could take longer than an hour.
That leaves Shuttlers with a difficult balancing act: make the ride cheap enough to attract passengers while keeping the vehicle productive enough to satisfy the operator.
Price is the ground Shuttlers has chosen to fight on, in a market where low fares, rising operating costs and intense competition have made ride-hailing difficult.
Uber’s global financial results show that its 2025 gross bookings averaged $14.26 per reported trip when total gross bookings are divided by total reported trips.
But that figure covers Uber’s global mobility, delivery and freight businesses and should not be treated as an average Uber fare. TechCabal’s reporting on Uber’s Nigerian exit found that individual Nigerian trips generated substantially lower values by comparison.
Rivals have also adapted their models to local conditions. Bolt accepts older vehicles than Uber did, while inDrive allows riders and drivers to negotiate fares.
Olokesusi thinks Pod can win there.
“If cost was one of the reasons Uber lost market share to other players in the ride-hailing space,” she said, a product still half the price of ride-hailing “can emerge as the number one solution in the space.”
Whether that happens will depend on something less visible than the fare displayed to passengers: occupancy.
Shuttlers needs enough commuters to share each Pod, enough routes to keep vehicles productive and enough repeat bookings to make the fixed-cost model work.
That is the same problem that has challenged carpooling startups before it.
“Three out of four sounds attractive on paper, but the real question is what you can charge per seat while remaining competitive and whether that revenue covers the full cost of the trip,” said Onifade.
“If you price too high, you’re competing with someone who can simply take a private Bolt or Uber. If you price too low, the platform fee and operator economics stop making sense,” Onifade added. “So I wouldn’t frame it as, “We only need three seats.” I’d first prove that the underlying unit economics work at all.”
Trust without the on-demand model
Shuttlers is also betting on trust.
The company’s first pilot ran in 2015, before Bolt launched in Lagos and before inDrive entered Nigeria. Its argument now is that a decade of operating scheduled transport gives it an advantage that a new carpooling platform would not have.
Shuttlers says Pod trips will be monitored by a live operations team, with AI used to flag unusual activity.
But Pod asks commuters to make a different trade-off from the one they make with Uber, Bolt or inDrive.
They give up spontaneity for a lower price.
They must know where they are going, book ahead, commit to recurring trips and, if they want the shared fare, wait for other people to join.
That may be the biggest test of the product.
Shuttlers has already shown that Nigerians will plan their commute around a scheduled bus. Now it wants to find out whether they will do the same for a car and whether enough of them will choose the same route at the same time, often enough to make the numbers work.
True scale demands moving beyond surface-level integrations to robust execution. articles.title: Google lanza aplicación de escritorio de Gemini para Windows: qué funciones ofrece
articles.text:
Google puso a disposición de todos los usuarios una aplicación oficial de escritorio de Gemini para Windows, tras un período de espera prolongado. La herramienta permite acceder al asistente de inteligencia artificial sin necesidad de abandonar la tarea que se esté realizando en el ordenador, mediante un acceso directo desde el teclado.
Con la combinación de teclas Alt + Espacio, Gemini se despliega junto a la aplicación que el usuario tenga abierta en ese momento. Desde esa ventana emergente es posible redactar textos, resumir documentos, buscar información o generar imágenes y videos, para luego regresar de inmediato a la tarea original sin necesidad de alternar entre distintas ventanas o pestañas.
PUBLICIDAD
Hasta ahora, el acceso a Gemini se realizaba principalmente a través del navegador. A diferencia de otros servicios de inteligencia artificial como ChatGPT, que ya contaban con aplicación de escritorio, Google demoró el lanzamiento de una versión nativa para Windows. La compañía cita como ejemplos de uso tareas habituales, como pulir un borrador, resumir un documento extenso o generar ideas nuevas.
La aplicación puede aprovechar el contexto del trabajo que el usuario tenga delante para ofrecer respuestas relacionadas con ese contenido específico. También permite realizar consultas rápidas y verificar información sin salir del flujo de trabajo, con el objetivo declarado de convertir a Gemini en una herramienta disponible en cualquier momento durante el uso del ordenador.
PUBLICIDAD
La integración alcanza a Gmail, Drive, Documentos y Calendar
Una de las funciones centrales de esta versión para Windows es su integración con el ecosistema de Google. La aplicación puede tomar información de servicios como Gmail, Google Drive, Documentos de Google y Google Calendar para incorporarla en sus respuestas.
Entre los usos posibles, el asistente puede localizar datos concretos dentro de un hilo de correos electrónicos, resumir un documento compartido o comparar las notas tomadas en distintas reuniones, todo esto directamente desde el ordenador. Esta función resulta relevante para quienes emplean de forma habitual los servicios de Google en su trabajo, ya que evita la búsqueda manual de información dispersa entre varias aplicaciones.
PUBLICIDAD
Nano Banana y Gemini Omni permiten crear imágenes y videos
La aplicación también incorpora las herramientas creativas de Google para la generación de contenido desde el escritorio. Los usuarios pueden crear imágenes personalizadas mediante Nano Banana y dirigir la generación de videos a través de Gemini Omni.
A esto se suma el acceso a Gemini Spark, el agente de inteligencia artificial de Google diseñado para procesos más complejos. Según explicó la compañía, Spark puede emplearse para delegar tareas de investigación, planificación y síntesis, con un funcionamiento autónomo pero siempre bajo la dirección del usuario.
PUBLICIDAD
El agente también asiste en tareas vinculadas con archivos locales, como la organización de carpetas o el resumen de documentos, cuya información puede después trasladarse a Documentos u Hojas de cálculo de Google.
Google prepara funciones adicionales orientadas a profundizar la integración de Gemini con el ordenador. Algunas de ellas ya se encuentran disponibles en macOS y llegarán próximamente a Windows, entre las que se cuenta la posibilidad de compartir la pantalla con el asistente para que la inteligencia artificial pueda comprender el contenido visible en ese momento, una función pensada para detectar errores o dar contexto adicional a las consultas.
PUBLICIDAD
Google amplía el uso de voz en Gmail, Docs y Keep
Google incorporó de forma reciente funciones de inteligencia artificial conversacional en Gmail, Google Docs y Keep, denominadas Gmail Live, Docs Live y Keep Live, que permiten interactuar con estas aplicaciones mediante voz y lenguaje natural.
El despliegue, presentado en mayo durante la conferencia Google I/O, comenzó en inglés y para dispositivos Android e iOS. Gmail Live permite formular preguntas sobre el contenido de la bandeja de entrada sin necesidad de escribir; Docs Live ayuda a elaborar un primer borrador a partir de una descripción hablada y puede recurrir a información de Gmail, Drive y Chat; mientras que Keep Live habilita el registro de ideas, recordatorios o notas mediante conversación.

articles.title: Melhor fone de ouvido Philips: 10 modelos que valem a pena em 2026 • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Melhor fone de ouvido Philips: 10 modelos que valem a pena em 2026
Encontre fones de ouvido Philips para o seu dia a dia; lista inclui modelos Bluetooth e com fio, com ANC, bateria duradoura e preço acessível
Os fones de ouvido da Philips são conhecidos pelo preço acessível, e atendem a propostas diferentes. A marca vende desde headphones com cancelamento ativo de ruído (ANC) até opções TWS compactas e dispositivos de construção aberta.
Neste guia, o Tecnoblog reuniu 10 fones Philips que valem a pena em 2026. Conheça as principais características de cada produto, além de prós e contras, antes de escolher o melhor para o seu dia a dia.
O TAH6509BK/00 é um fone over-ear que utiliza cancelamento ativo de ruído adaptativo com microfones internos e externos para identificar o ruído e ajustar o cancelamento em tempo real. Há ainda o modo ambiente que permite ouvir os sons externos, e o Quick Awareness, para facilitar conversas sem precisar retirar o fone.
Na reprodução, o headphone traz drivers dinâmicos de 40 mm, sistema acústico fechado e o recurso “Dynamic Bass”, que reforça as baixas frequências sem depender do aumento do volume. Sua autonomia chega a 70h com o cancelamento desligado e 45 horas com o ANC ativado, segundo a marca.
No geral, a conexão sem fio é feita por Bluetooth 5.3, com suporte ao codec SBC e multiponto para manter dois dispositivos conectados simultaneamente. O modelo também pode ser utilizado por cabo USB-C e possui entrada de áudio de 2,5 mm.
Codecs suportados: SBC
O SHP9500 é um headphone analógico com fio (drivers de 50 mm de neodímio e resposta de 12 Hz a 35 kHz) que promete som natural, grave encorpado e sem distorções. Ele conta com cabo destacável de três metros e adaptador P2/P6,3, facilitando a conexão com equipamentos de áudio profissionais.
Com cerca de 320 g, o SHP9500 é mais direcionado a quem pretende ouvir música em casa, trabalhar com áudio ou utilizar um headphone aberto em sessões mais longas. Ele não possui Bluetooth, bateria, ANC ou microfone integrado.
A ausência desses recursos não é acidental, pois a Philips prioriza uma conexão cabeada e uma arquitetura aberta sem isolamento acústico nesse modelo. Em vez de tentar bloquear o ambiente, as conchas permitem maior interação entre o som reproduzido e o espaço ao redor.
Codecs compatíveis: não se aplica ao modelo.
Para quem procura um TWS com cancelamento de ruído, o TAT3509GY/00 combina ANC adaptativo com um formato intra-auricular. O sistema utiliza cancelamento híbrido e o ajusta de acordo com o ambiente, relevante em locais com barulho constante, como transporte público, escritórios ou ambientes movimentados.
Os dois fones utilizam drivers dinâmicos de 10 mm e conexão Bluetooth 5.3 com suporte a multiponto e sensor infravermelho para pausa automática ao retirar um dos fones.
A autonomia varia de acordo com o uso do ANC: são até oito horas nos fones e 16 horas adicionais pelo estojo com o cancelamento desligado. Com ANC ativado, a estimativa cai para seis horas nos fones e mais 12 horas no estojo. Sua certificação IPX4 é limitada contra respingos e suor, e não protege contra poeira.
O TAT2500BK/00 é um fone intra-auricular que oferece ANC, multiponto e modo de transparência para ouvir o som ambiente. Os drivers dinâmicos têm 8 mm e a marca oferece o recurso Dynamic Bass, que pode ser ativado para reforçar as baixas frequências mesmo em volumes menores.
A conexão utiliza Bluetooth 5.4, com suporte ao aplicativo Philips Headphones para ajustar a equalização e outras configurações. Há também um microfone destinado às chamadas e dois microfones utilizados pelo sistema de ANC.
A bateria chega a seis horas de reprodução nos próprios fones com o ANC desligado, enquanto o estojo acrescenta outras 18 horas. No entanto, a marca não informa a autonomia com o ANC ativado. A certificação IPX4 protege contra respingos de água e suor, assim como no TAT3509GY/00.
Com construção over-ear, o TAH2300BK é voltado a quem prefere um headphone tradicional e não quer depender de recargas. As conchas fechadas ajudam no isolamento passivo, trazendo drivers dinâmicos de 40 mm e um modo Extra Bass, que altera a reprodução para reforçar as frequências graves.
A conectividade sem fio fica por conta do Bluetooth 5.4 e conexão multiponto para manter dois dispositivos conectados simultaneamente, o que pode ser útil para alternar entre computador e celular.
O headphone conta com microfone para chamadas e controles físicos, além de compatibilidade com assistentes de voz. Não há ANC ativo e a bateria integrada de 500 mAh oferece até 55 horas de reprodução, segundo a Philips. Ele não tem certificação IP contra água e poeira.
O TAQ2000BK/00 se diferencia pelo formato aberto com presilha que fica na parte externa da orelha. Em vez de vedar o canal auditivo como um fone intra-auricular, os drivers utilizam condução aérea para direcionar o som — característica que permite perceber o ambiente enquanto se ouve música, o que pode ser útil em caminhadas ou corridas.
A autonomia chega a sete horas por carga, com mais 21 horas fornecidas pelo estojo, segundo a marca. A classificação IPX4 indica proteção contra respingos e suor, mas não contra submersão.
O modelo traz drivers dinâmicos têm 12 mm e Bluetooth 5.4 com conexão multiponto para dois aparelhos simultaneamente, além de recursos como Dynamic Bass que reforça e amplifica os sons graves de músicas.
O TAT1139BK/00 adota um formato open-fit, sem a vedação típica das ponteiras de silicone que entram no canal auditivo. Isso oferece uma sensação mais aberta durante o uso, mas significa que a capacidade de isolamento passivo é menor do que a de modelos intra-auriculares.
O fone traz drivers dinâmicos de 13 mm para reprodução de áudio, Bluetooth 5.4 e microfone com processamento de IA para ligações.
Não há cancelamento ativo de ruído e o modelo tem autonomia para até seis horas de uso dos fones, enquanto o estojo acrescenta outras 20 horas. Ele conta com certificação IPX4, assim como outros modelos deste guia.
O TAH2209BK/00 é um fone com formato on-ear, dobrável e que pesa 141 gramas, ideal para mobilidade e uso prolongado. O áudio é reproduzido por drivers dinâmicos de 32 mm e pode receber reforço de graves por meio do recurso Dynamic Bass.
A transmissão sem fio utiliza Bluetooth 5.4, com codec SBC e multiponto para dois dispositivos. Um microfone integrado ao modelo também permite realizar chamadas sem precisar retirar o headphone.
A bateria proporciona até 25 horas de reprodução e leva aproximadamente duas horas para completar a carga por USB-C. Uma recarga rápida de 15 minutos adiciona cerca de uma hora de uso, de acordo com a Philips.
O TAT1209BK/00 é um fone intra-auricular simples, com drivers dinâmicos de 10 mm e também com recurso de reforço dinâmico de graves. Os fones utilizam ponteiras de silicone, que criam uma vedação física no canal auditivo e ajudam no isolamento passivo, mas não há ANC.
O modelo permite usar somente um dos lados enquanto o outro permanece no estojo, e os controles sensíveis ao toque podem comandar reprodução e chamadas. Há ainda um microfone para chamadas e compatibilidade com assistentes de voz via Bluetooth 5.3.
Cada carga fornece até seis horas de reprodução, enquanto o estojo acrescenta mais 12 horas. O carregamento completo leva cerca de duas horas, e 15 minutos de carga oferecem aproximadamente uma hora adicional. Ele também tem certificação IPX4 contra respingos e suor.
O TAH1108BK é um headphone on-ear compacto, com Bluetooth 5.2 e drivers dinâmicos de neodímio de 30 mm. Por não envolver completamente as orelhas, o isolamento é diferente daquele encontrado em headphones over-ear, e a percepção de sons externos tende a ser maior.
A proposta do modelo é oferecer praticidade: as conchas podem ser dobradas para dentro, reduzindo o espaço ocupado durante o transporte, e os comandos ficam diretamente no fone para controlar volume, reprodução e chamadas.
Ele pesa cerca de 180 gramas e sua bateria chega a 15 horas de reprodução com aproximadamente duas horas de carregamento.
A Philips possui modelos com propostas bastante diferentes, desde TWS compactos até headphones over-ear e opções de construção aberta. Considere o seguinte na hora da compra:
Os fones da Philips atendem a diferentes propostas, desde modelos básicos até headphones com ANC, multiponto e recursos de controle de ruído. A qualidade do fone e os recursos variam bastante entre as linhas, por isso a escolha deve considerar o modelo específico e suas tecnologias, e não apenas a marca.
O TAH6509BK/00 é o melhor fone de ouvido Bluetooth da Philips para quem procura um headphone sem fio com cancelamento ativo de ruído. Ele combina ANC híbrido adaptativo, conexão multiponto e até 45 horas de autonomia com o ANC ligado.
Se você prefere um fone intra-auricular, o Philips TAT3509GY/00 tem recursos semelhantes em um formato menor.
Alguns modelos possuem certificação IP, mas isso não é uma característica presente em toda a linha. Entre os modelos deste guia, os com classificação IPX4 tem limitações contra água e suor, sendo inferiores a fones com certificação IP54, IP55 ou IP68 de marcas como Apple e Samsung.
Para saber se um fone é original você deve combinar informações do próprio produto com a procedência da compra. Observe o seguinte:
Não é possível definir qual fone é melhor pois as duas marcas têm modelos de diferentes categorias e faixas de preço. A escolha deve considerar recursos específicos, como ANC, autonomia de bateria, resistência à água, formato e conectividade, já que os melhores fones da Philco também têm especificações avançadas e limitações técnicas.

articles.title: Productivity for Less—Windows 11 Pro Is Just $9.97 Right Now
articles.text:
Saturday, September 12th 2026
	
	
	
	
Productivity for Less—Windows 11 Pro Is Just $9.97 Right Now
Microsoft Windows 11 Pro is available for only $9.97 (MSRP $199) through Sept. 27, providing a lifetime license for one compatible PC with no recurring subscription fees. The Pro edition adds several features intended for professional, business, development, and IT use. BitLocker provides full-disk encryption for protecting data, while Hyper-V lets users run virtual machines. Windows Sandbox provides an isolated environment for testing applications, and Azure AD support is included for business identity and access management.
Windows 11 Pro also includes the core Windows 11 features. Snap layouts help organize multiple windows for multitasking, while DirectX 12 Ultimate supports gaming and graphics. Biometric login works with TPM 2.0, and the AI assistant Copilot is built in to handle tasks such as answering questions, summarizing content, generating images, and writing code.
For someone with a compatible PC that specifically needs a new Windows license, Windows 11 Pro at just $9.97 (MSRP $199) is a solid deal.Compatibility is particularly important with this license. Check Microsoft's PC Health Check app before purchasing to confirm that your computer meets the minimum Windows 11 system requirements. This version is intended for PCs that need a new Windows license and already meet those requirements.
There's also an important restriction for Windows 10 users: If your PC currently runs Windows 10 but cannot use Windows Update to install Microsoft's free Windows 11 upgrade, this license will not make that PC compatible with Windows 11 or allow this version to be installed.
It provides a lifetime license for one PC. The license is non-transferable, so it cannot later be moved to another computer. This is a digital purchase rather than a physical product, and nothing will be shipped.
For someone with a compatible PC that specifically needs a new Windows license, Windows 11 Pro at just $9.97 (MSRP $199) is a solid deal.

articles.title: We tested unofficial DLSS Multi Frame Generation support on RTX 40-series GPUs — new mod brings RTX 50-series exclusive feature to older cards, and it really works
articles.text:
We tested unofficial DLSS Multi Frame Generation support on RTX 40-series GPUs — new mod brings RTX 50-series exclusive feature to older cards, and it really works
But as with any mod, there are caveats
It’s been a heck of a time lately for PC gamers willing to get their hands dirty with mods. Hot on the heels of the discovery of the DLSS 5 DLL in a prerelease version of NBA 2K27, modder dashdogy found a way to bring Multi Frame Generation, one of the crown jewels of GeForce RTX 50-series graphics cards, to RTX 40-series (and earlier) products.
As already elevated graphics card prices seem set to continue rising, and hardware upgrades get further and further out of reach of the average PC gamer, more and more folks are going to want to hold on to the RTX 40-series hardware they have for as long as they can, especially if smoothness-boosting features like MFG are just a few clicks away on those older cards.
So we had to see MFG working on Ada for ourselves—assuming it works at all. We grabbed the mod files and got to playing with them in Cyberpunk 2077, since it’s likely in many TH readers’ Steam libraries already and has a healthy modding community. You can find the latest instructions for enabling MFG on Ada through dashdogy’s GitHub page.
Before spending a ton of time testing, we verified that the mod works at all. While spinning the camera at a high, constant speed, we could indeed see that increasing MFG multipliers beyond the officially supported 2X factor on Ada cards does greatly increase perceived smoothness or fluidity of motion in Cyberpunk 2077, as you would expect.
Another tell is that the same visual artifacts are visible in certain regions of the screen on both RTX 40-series and RTX 50-series graphics cards as you add more generated frames. MFG 4X and above, especially, tend to add some visual “junk” at the bottom of the frame that appears regardless of the game, and we could see that artifacting on Ada.
At least in Cyberpunk 2077, then, we’re confident that MFG is really doing its thing on RTX 40-series cards with this mod.
We also didn’t see any perceptible issues with frame pacing or frame delivery, although playing on a high-refresh-rate, G-Sync-Compatible monitor like our test bench’s ROG Strix XG27UCS smooths out all but the worst such issues. If you don’t have a high-resolution or high-refresh-rate monitor to begin with, the utility of MFG will be seriously limited for you anyway.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
The latency question
So is this a free lunch? Is Nvidia soft-locking MFG to Blackwell purely for marketing reasons? That’s where performance testing comes in, since it has the potential to reveal whether there’s a catch in running MFG on Ada. The question is not so much whether MFG juices output frame rates, but whether it runs on Ada within acceptable latency thresholds.
As we’ve long emphasized, when you have essentially arbitrary control over output frame rates like MFG allows, input lag becomes the final barrier to a playable experience. So in the performance results that follow, we’ll certainly present output frame rates as you would expect. But you should view those in the context of your own monitor’s refresh rate. As long as the delivered frame rates we recorded exceed your display’s peak refresh rate, you have headroom to play with to keep your monitor at or near that number during gameplay.
The real issue, then, is whether both RTX 40-series and 50-series cards deliver an acceptable input latency under our test conditions. In our past testing, we’ve determined that a roughly 60ms average latency threshold, as indicated by Nvidia’s FrameView app, is the point at which player inputs and displayed frames start to become noticeably decoupled in AAA single-player experiences like Cyberpunk.
If you’re only slightly on the wrong side of this threshold, a game might still be playable, but if you totally blow past it, you’re likely to notice laggy inputs and increasingly distracting visual artifacts as the MFG model struggles to fill in the gaps between sparser and sparser input data.
Testing methods and notes
As one of the biggest technical showcases of the current PC gaming era, Cyberpunk 2077 lets us enable all the modern rendering features we’d want for Nvidia cards. It implements not only ray tracing and path tracing, but DLSS Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, and Multi Frame Generation. The number of AI-generated pixels per frame can be quite high in this title.
We enabled all those features to expose the full potential complexity of running all of their associated AI models in a modern rendering pipeline. If RTX 40-series cards are going to stumble for some reason with modded MFG enabled, we want to put as many obstacles in their way as possible.
And because benchmarking the performance of an unofficial mod is venturing into the Wild West anyway, we also added a DLSS 5 mod to the mix to see whether Blackwell GPUs have a distinct edge in the neural rendering future that the arrival of that feature promises to usher in. DLSS 5 is supposed to come to RTX 40-series cards later this year, so we think it’s good to understand where performance sits today, even if it’s subject to the same disclaimers as this MFG mod.
For reference, then, we tested Cyberpunk with maxed-out raster settings, path tracing, and MFG 4X at three resolutions: 1080p with DLSS Balanced, 2560x1440 with DLSS Performance, and 4K with DLSS Ultra Performance upscaling enabled.
We only tested cards ranging from the RTX 4090 down to the RTX 4070 for these experiments, both because of time and Cyberpunk’s VRAM requirements. We didn’t want to deal with potential performance pitfalls due to running out of VRAM, so the 12GB RTX 4070 is where we’re drawing the line for now.
Modded Cyberpunk 2077 1080p performance
At 1080p, Cyberpunk 2077 with MFG 4X scales fine on Ada, but it’s clearly scaling better on Blackwell. The RTX 4090 lands between the RTX 5070 Ti and RTX 5089. Introducing DLSS 5 to the mix doesn’t change any relative standings, although it does create some larger gaps between average frame rates and 1% lows than we might like on the RTX 4070 Ti Super, RTX 4070 Ti, RTX 4070 Super, and RTX 4070. The RTX 5070 has no such trouble.
But again, the real story is in our latency results. Here, we can see that every card we tested falls under our 60ms threshold with MFG 4X alone. But Blackwell hardware has a clear advantage in the standings, as even the RTX 5070 delivers a lower input latency than the RTX 4090 with our DLSS 5 mod off and a comparable input latency with it enabled. All the other Ada cards shake out as you would expect from there. But in absolute terms, even with DLSS 5 enabled, only the RTX 4070 Super and RTX 4070 are far beyond our acceptable latency thresholds.
Blackwell might have a latency edge with MFG enabled and a smoothness edge with a modded version of DLSS 5 on top, but at least with the RTX 4070 on up, there’s certainly enough headroom to use the feature on Ada.
And as we went to press, a version of the RTX 40-series MFG mod came out that removes the need for ReShade. That more streamlined approach might cut down latency, but we couldn’t test it because it currently crashes Cyberpunk 2077. Again, this is the Wild West, not a validated, bulletproof solution from Nvidia like you get with RTX 50-series products.
Modded Cyberpunk 2077 2560x1440 performance
At 2560x1440, generational performance standings and scaling between cards remains much the same as we saw at 1080p. The RTX 4090 still falls short of the RTX 5080, and the RTX 4080 duo falls behind the RTX 5070 Ti.
We also still see the wide gap between average frame rates and 1% lows rear its head on more Ada cards with our DLSS 5 mod enabled, though to be fair, these lows are still being smoothed over by MFG to the point that you’re unlikely to notice them with a high-refresh-rate, variable-refresh-rate monitor like we’re using.
On the latency side, all of the Ada cards except the RTX 4070 still run our modded MFG 4X with acceptable input latency. But enable the DLSS 5 mod we’re using, and input latency climbs past 60ms for all Ada cards except the RTX 4090. The RTX 4080 Super and RTX 4080 still provide acceptable performance under this full load, as they’re only slightly over our latency threshold. But for any less powerful RTX 40-series cards, you’d need to start choosing between DLSS 5 and other eye candy, like lighter RT settings instead of path tracing or no RT or PT at all.
Modded Cyberpunk 2077 4K performance
Our modded performance results at 4K with DLSS Ultra Performance demonstrate why it’s so important to discuss MFG-boosted frame rates in the context of input latency. If you’re not mentally dividing by four, everything on our output frame rate might look playable.
At this high output resolution, the RTX 4090 finally takes the lead over the RTX 5080, both with plain MFG 4X and with our DLSS 5 mod on top. The 16GB of VRAM of the RTX 4070 Ti Super would seem to be giving it an edge over the RTX 4070 Ti and RTX 5070, and the RTX 4080 duo would seem to beat out the RTX 5070 Ti.
Our latency chart for MFG 4X shows a weird, but entirely reproducible result: input latencies at 4K with DLSS Ultra Performance are actually much lower than they are at 2560x1440 for most Ada cards, despite the fact that both of these output resolution targets share the same input resolution.
We’re not sure why Ada cards run into such a latency hump with this MFG mod at 2560x1440 with DLSS Performance, but we double-checked our results, and this behavior is reproducible. Blackwell cards experience the more linear rise in input latency as output resolutions rise that you would expect.
Again, this is the Wild West of modded performance, and we have nobody to blame but ourselves here, but it’s an unfortunate result given the prevalence of 2560x1440 monitors. Perhaps the maintainers of this mod can track down the root cause and fix it, but nothing is guaranteed.
In any event, input latency with MFG 4X alone at 4K with DLSS Ultra Performance isn’t an issue for any card here. You might be pushing your luck with the RTX 4070, but both Blackwell and Ada cards are delivering on the promise of MFG here: smoother output with responsive input.
Add DLSS 5 to the latency picture, though, and as we’ve come to expect, you really want an RTX 5090, RTX 4090, or RTX 5080 for acceptable responsiveness. And you’re pushing it with the RTX 5080. No other cards in this bunch need apply.
Bottom line
Our experience with the purportedly Blackwell-exclusive Multi Frame Generation on RTX 40-series cards through modding suggests that there isn’t any glaring reason why Nvidia couldn’t enable the feature for Ada Lovelace cards, and that’s kind of wild given how heavily it was touted as a Blackwell-exclusive feature back when those cards launched.
At least as long as Nvidia doesn’t find a persistent way to lock it out, our experience is that MFG generally just works on Ada. Even if input latencies aren’t quite as low on those older cards as they are on comparable Blackwell hardware, all else equal, they’re still perfectly acceptable, even under the combined load of path tracing, DLSS Super Resolution, DLSS Ray Reconstruction, and MFG 4X in Cyberpunk 2077.
We only had time to test cards ranging down to the RTX 4070 for this quick look, but for folks looking to extend the useful life of their Ada hardware, the availability of MFG could certainly stretch those cards’ lifespans.
But our experience also shows that MFG on Ada isn’t perfect. It’s still a mod in active development, and the unusual and reproducible input latency behavior we charted at 1440p on RTX 40-series cards is the sort of unexpected pitfall you might expect from an unofficial implementation of the feature. Cross your fingers that it’s an issue that can be fixed by the community.
The fact that MFG works as well as it does on Ada, even in this modded form, also makes us wonder whether Nvidia might just enable official support for it at some point, given the apparently bleak prospects for gaming graphics card pricing and future hardware generations as the AI boom shows no signs of abating. And such a move would provide much broader and more immediate performance relief for gamers than re-introducing ancient silicon like the RTX 3060.
Given that Nvidia is already working on bringing DLSS 5 to RTX 40-series GPUs, maybe this mod will convince it to throw in official MFG support, too. Fingers crossed.
Follow Tom's Hardware on Google News, or add us as a preferred source, to get our latest news, analysis, & reviews in your feeds.
As the Senior Analyst, Graphics at Tom's Hardware, Jeff Kampman covers everything that has to do with graphics cards, gaming performance, and more. From integrated graphics processors to discrete graphics cards to the hyperscale installations powering our AI future, if it's got a GPU in it, Jeff is on it.

articles.title: Mission zu Alpha Centauri: KI berechnet Route für 80.000-Jahre-Reise
articles.text:
Raumschiff zu Alpha Centauri: Diese KI hat die Route berechnet
Die Organisation Fermi Explorer Mission beabsichtigt, bis Ende 2029 ein unbemanntes Raumschiff zu Alpha Centauri zu schicken. Es handelt sich um eine äußerst ehrgeizige Mission: Wenn alles gut läuft, könnte das Raumschiff bis zu 80.000 Jahre benötigen, um das der Erde am nächsten gelegene Sternensystem zu erreichen. Es liegt 4,4 Lichtjahre entfernt. Das Raumschiff soll dabei einer neuartigen Flugbahn folgen, die von einem KI-System stammt. Entwickelt hat die KI Physical Superintelligence (PSI), ein KI-Forschungslabor für Physik. PSI kann auf eine Finanzierung in Höhe von 58 Millionen US-Dollar verweisen, die maßgeblich von Breakthrough Energy stammt, einer auf Klimaschutz ausgerichteten Investmentfirma, die von Microsoft-Mitbegründer Bill Gates gestartet wurde.
    
Auf der Mission, Alpha Centauri zu erreichen
Es ist nicht das erste Mal, dass es solche Versuche gibt. Im Jahr 2016 kündigte der milliardenschwere Tech-Investor Yuri Milner eine interstellare Mission namens Breakthrough Starshot an, um das allererste menschliche Raumschiff nach Alpha Centauri zu schicken. Der Plan sah vor, leistungsstarke Laser einzusetzen, die winzige Sonden auf ein Fünftel der Lichtgeschwindigkeit beschleunigen sollten – schnell genug, um Alpha Centauri innerhalb von nur 20 Jahren zu erreichen. Milner stellte 100 Millionen Dollar für ein Proof-of-Concept-System zur Verfügung. Doch auch ein Jahrzehnt später startet noch nichts. „Wir wollten kein weiteres Breakthrough Starshot“, sagt Philip Johnston, Mitbegründer und Präsident bei Fermi Explorer Mission. Man sei fest entschlossen, tatsächlich etwas starten zu lassen. Die neue Mission, die derzeit von privaten Einzelspendern finanziert wird, soll voraussichtlich 15 Millionen Dollar kosten.

articles.title: Las 5 series de terror del año que todo fan debería ver
articles.text:
Si eres fanático del género, ya lo sabes: Las series de terror se han convertido en un fenómeno a gran escala. En parte porque el streaming les ha brindado un nuevo impulso. Pero además, porque lejos de depender exclusivamente de los tradicionales jump scares o el gore gratuito, las nuevas historias terroríficas apuntan a la complejidad. Eso, al fusionar el horror psicológico con profundos dramas familiares, críticas sociales y dilemas existenciales. Este cambio de enfoque ha permitido que títulos emblemáticos trasciendan el nicho de fanáticos del terror para cautivar a un público masivo y generalista.
Claro está, no es un fenómeno casual. Las plataformas han sabido capitalizar este interés otorgando presupuestos generosos a creadores con visiones autorales únicas. Algo que se traduce en una factura técnica impecable, cinematografía de primer nivel y actuaciones memorables que dignifican el género. Al final, el éxito radica en que estas series de terror no solo asustan por los monstruos que muestran en pantalla. También lo hacen por cómo reflejan los miedos colectivos e individuales de nuestra sociedad actual.
Pero sin duda, el formato serializado beneficia al terror. Eso, al privilegiar la construcción de atmósferas densas y narrativas complejas imposibles de desarrollar en el cine convencional de dos horas. El streaming permite un desarrollo de personajes minucioso, donde el terror se cocina a fuego lento. A la vez, la tensión se acumula de manera insostenible a lo largo de múltiples episodios. Esta continuidad estructural fomenta el fenómeno del maratón, atrapando a los usuarios en bucles de misterio donde la necesidad de respuestas supera al miedo de seguir mirando. Si eres de estos últimos, esta lista es para ti. Te dejamos cinco series de terror que ya deberías estar viendo. De un fenómeno que sorprendió por su originalidad a una serie que causa adicción. Todo para los amantes del género.
La maldición de Widow’s Bay (Apple TV)
Esta es la serie que demuestra que la plataforma de los de Cupertino también puede probar con el terror y triunfar. Algo que La maldición de Widow’s Bay demuestra con su impecable equilibrio entre tensión atmosférica y un ácido humor negro. Creada por Katie Dippold y con la dirección de cineastas del género como Ti West, la trama nos traslada a una remota y neblinosa isla de Nueva Inglaterra. Una cuyo obstinado alcalde intenta revitalizar el turismo local.
Pero cuando una serie de desapariciones y perturbadores fenómenos marinos muestran una sangrienta maldición ancestral, La maldición de Widow’s Bay se convierte en una joya. Con una atmósfera gris, opresiva y profundamente aislada, la serie maneja la incomodidad de manera magistral. Por lo que hace que la niebla y las supersticiones locales cobren una fuerza física aterradora.
Sin embargo, el verdadero triunfo de La maldición de Widow’s Bay entre las series de terror contemporáneas es salirse del molde. Todo con una sátira social hacia la negación humana frente a un peligro inminente. También, su factura visual, su ingenio disonante y sus escalofriantes secuencias de horror corporal. Ideal para fanáticos.
Algo terrible está a punto de suceder (Netflix)
Producida bajo el ala creativa de los hermanos Duffer y creada por Haley Z. Boston, esta serie de terror de ocho episodios sorprendió desde su estreno. Eso debido a su mezcla de horror psicológico y sobrenatural. La premisa sigue a una joven pareja, interpretada por Camila Morrone y Adam DiMarco. Ambos están a punto de contraer matrimonio. Por lo que viajan a una recóndita propiedad en el norte del estado de Nueva York para celebrar su semana de bodas.
A medida que los días avanzan, la celebración se sumerge en una pesadilla claustrofóbica. Todo, cuando la protagonista es acechada por una implacable certeza de catástrofe y el comportamiento cada vez más siniestro de su familia política. La serie de terror desentierra una retorcida maldición generacional donde la falta de una fe absoluta en el matrimonio. Y por si eso no fuera suficiente, también desencadena transformaciones biológicas y destinos letales.
Con un aire de surrealismo lynchiano y una fotografía calculadamente lúgubre, la serie atrapa desde el primer episodio. Algo que permite a esta serie de terror edificar una espeluznante historia, basada en la ansiedad conyugal. También, en la lenta descomposición de la cordura.
The Beauty (Disney+)
Ryan Murphy ataca de nuevo y esta vez lo hace con una serie de terror sorprendente. Eso al mezclar horror corporal y suspenso conspiranoico. Todo para adaptar de manera brillante el cómic The Beauty de Image Comics, creado por Jeremy Haun y Jason A. Hurley. El resultado es una historia retorcida, que plasma los peores miedos de la sociedad contemporánea.
Ambientada en el circuito de la alta moda internacional, la serie comienza con la grotesca y misteriosa muerte de varias supermodelos en París. Lo que obliga a un par de agentes del FBI a investigar una red global de intrigas corporativas. Pronto descubren la existencia de The Beauty, una mutación viral de transmisión sexual modificada genéticamente. Pero además, tiene un trasfondo grotesco. Otorga la perfección física absoluta a sus huéspedes, pero que esconde un período de incubación con efectos secundarios mortales y viscerales.
Con un elenco estelar que incluye a Evan Peters, Rebecca Hall e Isabella Rossellini, la serie de terror explora la alienación estética y la codicia tecnológica. Pero también la dismorfia social a través de una puesta en escena pulp y sofisticada. Ideal para los fanáticos del terror extremo.
Si los deseos mataran… (Netflix)
Esta serie de terror original surcoreana dirigida por Park Youn-seo mezcla el pánico moral de la era digital con el ocultismo tradicional. Para eso, la historia sigue a un grupo de cinco estudiantes de preparatoria cuyas vidas se transforman en una pesadilla literal. Todo, tras descargar una enigmática aplicación móvil llamada Girigo, la cual promete conceder cualquier deseo a cambio de un precio terrible.
Conforme sus peticiones se materializan, los jóvenes entran en una implacable cuenta regresiva de 24 horas que precede a una muerte violenta e inevitable. Lo que desata una ola de paranoia, traiciones y desesperación por romper el ciclo. Para eso, la trama entrelaza la ansiedad tecnológica de la Generación Z con las raíces del chamanismo coreano (mu-sok). Además, claro, de los espíritus vengativos nacidos del remordimiento escolar.
Con una atmósfera asfixiante y escenas de alta tensión psicológica, esta serie de terror se convirtió en un fenómeno global. Todo debido a su ritmo frenético y su brutal reflexión sobre las consecuencias de los deseos egoístas.
From (Movistar+)
La decana de las series de terror actuales cuenta lo que parece una historia sencilla. Un misterioso y terrorífico pueblo perdido en el mapa parece corriente hasta que se descubre su secreto. Nadie puede escapar una vez que ingresa. Los residentes, obligados a construir una apariencia de normalidad para no volverse locos, deben lidiar no solo con la desesperación de encontrar una salida. También con el terror que acecha cada noche. Unas criaturas sedientas de sangre que adoptan forma humana y cazan sin piedad a cualquiera que se quede fuera de sus casas al caer el sol.
Una vuelta de tuerca enigmática que esta serie de terror utiliza para indagar en una atmósfera asfixiante y un constante sentido de misterio. A través de un ritmo frenético lleno de giros argumentales y un elenco coral bien desarrollado, la serie explora la psicología humana. Todo bajo un estado de amenaza constante, convirtiéndose en una de las producciones de horror psicológico más aclamadas de los últimos años. También, en un fenómeno de las teorías. Si lo tuyo es descubrir el misterio de terror de turno, esta es tu serie de terror.

articles.title: Você teria? Vaza o dispositivo diferentão da Meta para usar no rosto • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Você teria? Vaza o dispositivo diferentão da Meta para usar no rosto
Imagem revela headset em estrutura mais parecida com óculos tradicionais.
Imagens encontradas no aplicativo HorizonOS, da Meta, revelaram detalhes do próximo dispositivo smart da empresa, que lembra óculos e foi desenvolvido sob o codigonome Phoenix. Ele deve ser apresentado durante o Meta Connect 2026, que ocorre nos próximos dias 23 e 24.
O material mostra óculos muito diferentes dos headsets de realidade virtual da linha Quest, com design mais fino e armações semelhantes às convencionais, incluindo sensores instalados nas hastes. O aparelho é diferentão o suficiente para que você não ande na rua com ele, deixando isso para os óculos inteligentes tradicionais, com o em parceria com a Ray-Ban.
As imagens mostram detalhes como:
Os óculos de realidade virtual acabaram não sendo o sucesso que a indústria imaginava há alguns anos, o que, inclusive, colocou o Reality Labs em crise. Mas o principal nome da Meta neste campo acredita que o ponto é trazer as “vitórias” do Quest para aparelhos mais amigáveis.
“Há headsets por aí que entregam [mais recursos] e ninguém está os usando. […] Eu acho que leveza é um fator primordial em um headset. Eu acho que é mais importante que um monte de outros recursos”.
– Andrew Bosworth, em 2025
Apesar de lembrar óculos inteligentes, o Phoenix deve ser um headset de realidade virtual com lentes opacas. Ou seja, as imagens do ambiente que o usuário verá serão capturadas por câmeras e exibidas em telas internas.
A redução de tamanho vem da remoção de grande parte do hardware da estrutura principal. A placa-mãe, o processador e a bateria (a exemplo do Apple Vision Pro) devem passar para um módulo externo, chamado Stanley. O acessório se parece com um carregador portátil, tem saídas de ar para refrigeração e uma presilha para prendê-lo ao corpo. Ele é conectado ao headset por um cabo.
Os registros no Horizon OS indicam que o Phoenix deve usar o Snapdragon Reality Elite, lançado em junho pela Qualcomm. Outros vazamentos da cadeia de fornecedores apontam para telas micro OLED de 2560 x 2560 pixels.
O controle do sistema deve abandonar os joysticks usados pelos Quest: agora, a interação seria baseada em rastreamento ocular e gestos com as mãos. Isso, em grande parte, porque o foco pode estar no consumo de mídia, não mais em joguinhos de realidade virtual.
O aparelho também teria o Eye Unlock, sistema de autenticação baseado nos olhos para desbloqueio e compras. A tecnologia seria semelhante ao Optic ID, da Apple.
Outro recurso, que também lembra algo feito pelo Vision Pro, é o suporte aos Codec Avatars, que cria representações dos usuários em chamadas. Aqui, no entanto, devem ser avatares fotorrealistas.

articles.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash: Google schließt zu Claude auf – zum halben Preis
articles.text:
Google gegen Anthropic: Gemini 3.8 Flash schließt Lücke – für die Hälfte des Preises
Kurz nachdem Anthropic Mythos 5.1 und Fable 5.1 auf den Markt gebracht hat, veröffentlicht Google jetzt ebenfalls zwei neue Modellversionen. Diese basieren auf demselben Grundmodell, sind aber unterschiedlich optimiert. Während Gemini 3.8 Flash den Fokus auf Programmierung, KI-Agenten und komplexe Schlussfolgerungen legt, wurde Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber speziell für die Suche und Behebung von Software-Schwachstellen trainiert.
So gut schlägt sich 3.8 Flash im Vergleich
Für Google ist es schon der dritte Flash-Release innerhalb weniger Wochen. Die Version 3.7 Flash kam vor gerade einmal drei Wochen auf den Markt. Laut Unternehmensangaben ist Gemini 3.8 Flash das bislang beste Reasoning- und Coding-Modell des Tech-Konzerns.
Beim „DeepSWE v1.1“-Benchmark, der komplexe, eigenständige Software-Engineering-Aufgaben abfragt, verbesserte sich die neue Version deutlich und liegt laut Unternehmensangaben jetzt nur noch knapp hinter Claude Opus 5 von Anthropic. Bei „HLE-Verified” führt Gemini 3.8 Flash das Ranking an. Dabei handelt es sich um einen Benchmark für vielschichtige Schlussfolgerungen über diverse Themen und Berufsfelder hinweg.
Die Preise bleiben gegenüber der Vorgängerversion unverändert. Eine Million Input-Token kosten 0,75 Dollar und eine Million Output-Token 3,75 Dollar. Damit positioniert sich Google im Vergleich zu den Modellen anderer Anbieter deutlich günstiger. So kostet OpenAIs GPT-5.6 Sol für dieselbe Token-Menge 4 Dollar beziehungsweise 20 Dollar und Claude Opus 5 von Anthropic 5 Dollar beziehungsweise 25 Dollar.
Dennoch könnten die Kosten für die Arbeit mit 3.8 Flash höher ausfallen als bei der Vorgängerversion. Der Grund: Die neue Gemini-Version wendet für komplexe Aufgaben mehr Rechenleistung auf und könnte dadurch mehr Token verbrauchen.
Google startet neue Sicherheitsinitiative
Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber ist auf die Arbeit im Cybersecurity-Bereich spezialisiert. Die Modellversion enthält weniger restriktive Schutzmechanismen, um die „Verteidigungsanforderungen in der Praxis besser zu erfassen” und Schwachstellen gezielt beheben zu können. Laut Google löst Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber auf dem Open-Source-Benchmark-Framework Cybergym mit einem Versuch 86,2 Prozent der Aufgaben. Damit landet es knapp vor GPT-5.5-Cyber von OpenAI, das nur 85,6 Prozent erreichte.
Beim Patching-Test „CWE-Bench” erreicht die neue Modellversion von Google 47,2 Prozent und liegt damit knapp hinter Fable 5 von Anthropic.
Google stellt Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber im Rahmen des neuen „Fairwind Program“ nur ausgewählten Nutzer:innen zur Verfügung. In einem Blogbeitrag über das Projekt heißt es: „Der Einsatz modernster KI-Technologien kann Menschen dabei helfen, kritische Sicherheitslücken schnell aufzudecken – und zu beheben. In den falschen Händen können dieselben Technologien jedoch zu einer ebenso großen Bedrohung werden.”
Google nennt schon mehr als 650 Partnerunternehmen, darunter Crowdstrike und Snowflake. Die neue Initiative ähnelt denen von Anthropic und OpenAI. Auch sie haben bestimmte Modelle aus Sicherheitsgründen nicht öffentlich zugänglich gemacht.

articles.title: Esta serie hecha con IA está arrasando en el horario estelar de la televisión china
articles.text:
Cuando la pelea entre Tom Cruise y Brad Pitt se hizo viral, muchos usuarios imaginaron que una película hecha completamente con IA estaba a nada de hacerse realidad. Aunque OpenAI y otras empresas occidentales dejaron de lado los modelos de video para enfocarse en otras áreas, China no siguió este camino y hoy ha estrenado Beyond Wukong, una de las primeras series generadas con IA a gran escala.
Basada en la novela del siglo XVI, Beyond Wukong lleva desde finales de agosto ocupando el horario estelar de la televisión china sin un solo actor humano en pantalla. De acuerdo con Chosun, todas las escenas que miran los televidentes en el bloque de las 8 de la noche fueron generadas por medio de IA. Estas van desde Sun Wukong y los ejércitos que aparecen en pantalla, hasta los paisajes montañosos que sirven como escenario.
Aunque algunas escenas tienen errores de continuidad visibles, como personajes que aparecen con las manos vacías en un plano y sostienen un bastón en el siguiente, la audiencia ha respondido mejor de lo que se esperaba. Beyond Wukong se posicionó como la serie más vista entre los canales satelitales durante su estreno y mantiene su popularidad hasta hoy.
De qué va Beyond Wukong, la serie china hecha totalmente con IA
Según el comunicado de prensa, Beyond Wukong toma como base una de las tres secuelas más relevantes de Viaje al Oeste, la novela clásica, escrita durante finales de la dinastía Ming e inicios de la Qing. La historia se ubica mil años después de que Sun Wukong alcanzara la iluminación budista y sigue a una nueva generación de personajes que se embarcan en una misión para recuperar las escrituras sagradas.
El proyecto es responsabilidad de Mango TV, que ha echado mano de su Centro de Innovación de Contenido AIGC para el desarrollo de la serie. Sus creadores señalan que el proceso de producción tomó apenas tres meses, contando desde la planeación hasta el estreno. Esto contrasta con los dos años que requiere una serie china convencional para materializar el guion, rodaje, postproducción y ajustes finales antes de su proyección.
Li Dongxian, director de Beyond Wukong, explicó que cada episodio de 40 minutos tiene un coste aproximado de 900.000 yuanes, algo así como 115.00 euros. Esta cifra representa menos de una décima parte de lo que cuesta una serie de animación comercial. Dongxian añade que una escena de batalla de tres minutos, como la que ocurre en el episodio 3, habría costado entre 4 y 5 millones de yuanes con técnicas tradicionales de CGI, pero con la IA consiguieron rodarla por un rango de entre 20.000 y 30.000 yuanes.
La serie de Beyond Wukong se apoya en la plataforma LumeCreate AIGC y cuenta con un equipo de casi 100 personas. A diferencia de los cortos de uno o dos minutos que vemos con Seedance, la producción desarrolló un sistema pensado para series largas. Esto requiere más coherencia narrativa y continuidad de los personajes y las escenas.
La IA le está quitando trabajo a los actores reales
Los primeros cinco episodios de la temporada se concentran en el arco de la Montaña de Flores y Frutos, con historias que combinan celebraciones y funerales marinos para retratar tanto la prosperidad como la tragedia de ese mundo mítico. Para conseguirlo, el equipo creativo se inspiró en pinturas tradicionales chinas y todos los elementos visuales, como arquitectura, vestuarios, materiales y paletas de colores, se diseñaron y refinaron a través de múltiples iteraciones.
Vale la pena señalar que Beyond Wukong no es la primera serie generada con IA en China. De acuerdo con un análisis, el 95% de las producciones de formato corto que se estrenaron durante el primer trimestre de 2026, se crearon con inteligencia artificial. Esto ha tenido un impacto en los actores y equipos de producción humanos, quienes vieron una reducción en salarios y cantidad de proyectos para trabajar.

articles.title: Instagram-Chef verteidigt Algorithmus: Warum chronologische Feeds sogar mehr Werbung enthalten könnten
articles.text:
„Ich glaube nicht, dass Instagram süchtig macht“: Mosseri verteidigt Feed-Algorithmus
Die australische Regierung geht schon länger mit entschlossenen Schritten voran, wenn es um die Beschränkung sozialer Medien geht. Nachdem das Land Ende letzten Jahres als erstes weltweit ein Verbot von Apps wie Tiktok, Facebook und Snapchat für Nutzer:innen unter 16 Jahren beschlossen hat, diskutiert es jetzt die Möglichkeit, sich aktiv gegen Algorithmen entscheiden zu können. Aber nicht alle sind überzeugt. So sagt Instagram-Chef Adam Mosseri, Nutzer:innen hätten in einer algorithmusfreien Welt eine schlechtere Nutzungserfahrung und würden mehr markenbezogene Inhalte sehen.
Kritik an suchterzeugenden Designs wird lauter
Ursprünglich zeigten soziale Medien Posts in chronologischer Reihenfolge an. Das änderte sich mit der Zeit: Heute arbeiten die Plattformen mit Algorithmen, um Inhalte individuell zu sortieren. Für die Betreiber hat das den Vorteil, dass Nutzer:innen länger auf den Plattformen bleiben. Kritiker:innen bemängeln allerdings, dass die Feeds nicht neutral sind, sondern nach wirtschaftlichen Zielen optimiert werden. Weil Algorithmen das Engagement maximieren sollen, würden sie Inhalte bevorzugen, die starke Emotionen auslösen und so auch Hassrede und Desinformationen befeuern.
Auch das Suchtpotenzial steht im Fokus. In den USA warf eine junge Frau Instagram und Youtube vor, ihre Plattformen absichtlich so zu gestalten, dass sie Nutzer:innen süchtig machen. Eigenen Angaben zufolge hätte sie teilweise 16 Stunden täglich auf Instagram verbracht, den Kontakt zu ihrer Familie abgebrochen und infolge der Sucht Depressionen und Angstzustände entwickelt. Das Gericht kam zu dem Schluss, dass die Unternehmen Meta und Alphabet fahrlässig gehandelt und nicht ausreichend vor den Risiken ihrer Plattformen gewarnt hätten, und sprach der Klägerin drei Millionen Dollar Schmerzensgeld zu.
Wie sinnvoll sind chronologische Feeds?
Vor diesem Hintergrund kündigte der australische Premierminister Anthony Albanese in einer Pressemitteilung Pläne an, Social-Media-Plattformen dazu zu verpflichten, Nutzer:innen die Wahl zwischen einem algorithmisch und einem chronologisch geordneten Feed zu überlassen. Bei einer Pressekonferenz zur Einführung von „Algo Confessions” nahm Mosseri indirekt zu diesem Vorschlag Stellung. In der neuen Videoserie erklären Prominente und Influencer:innen, wie Instagram bestimmt, welche Inhalte im Feed einer Person landen.
Laut The Guardian sagte er, eine „sehr lautstarke Minderheit” wolle die Rückkehr zu chronologisch sortierten Feeds. Das würde dazu führen, dass diejenigen, die es sich leisten können, noch mehr posten und dadurch eine größere Reichweite erzielen. Dabei handele es sich allerdings nicht um Privatpersonen – sondern um professionelle Creator:innen und Unternehmen. Durch eine Abschaltung des Algorithmus würden das Engagement und die Zufriedenheit einbrechen. Letztlich würden die Nutzer:innen das Interesse an der App verlieren.
Mosseri weist Kritik am Algorithmus zurück
Eine Rückkehr zu chronologischen Feeds hält Mosseri deshalb für nicht sinnvoll. „Das soll nicht heißen, dass das Ranking perfekt ist – das ist es nicht, wir machen Fehler“, so der Instagram-Chef laut The Guardian. Trotzdem bemühe sich das Unternehmen, den Nutzer:innen Kontrolle über ihre Feeds zu geben und ihnen das zu zeigen, was sie wirklich interessiert. Den Vorwurf, der Algorithmus sei suchterzeugend, wies er zurück: „Ich glaube nicht, dass Instagram süchtig macht. Ich weiß, dass diese Aussage umstritten ist.“ Es ist nicht das erste Mal, dass Mosseri diese Position öffentlich vertritt – obwohl es wiederholt zu Gerichtsverfahren kam und die Forderung nach besseren Schutzmaßnahmen lauter werden.

articles.title: De sa formalisation par des chercheurs de Google en 2022 à son intégration native dans les modèles d'OpenAI, la chaîne de pensée (chain-of-thought ou CoT), a changé la manière dont l'IA raisonne. Mais cette fenêtre ouverte sur son fonctionnement interne pourrait bientôt se refermer.
articles.text:
Le 6 septembre 2026, dans un article de blog intitulé An Alien Mind (« un esprit alien »), Jakub Pachocki, chef scientifique d’OpenAI, revient sur les dernières années de développement de l’IA.
Il y raconte notamment comment, en 2023, son équipe a obtenu les premiers résultats suffisamment encourageants pour envisager de développer massivement l’apprentissage par renforcement (reinforcement learning) appliqué à l’entraînement des modèles.
Une avancée qui, à l’époque, ouvrait une nouvelle voie : au lieu d’enseigner à l’IA comment raisonner étape par étape, cette méthode la laisse apprendre à le faire elle-même, par essais successifs, en étant récompensée quand elle trouve la bonne réponse.
Trois ans plus tard, les modèles de raisonnement pèsent de plus en plus lourd dans l’économie et repoussent désormais les limites de la recherche scientifique.
Point essentiel de cette méthode : le chain-of-thought, souvent abrégé en CoT (que l’on pourrait traduire par « chaîne de pensée » ou « raisonnement en chaîne »), le mécanisme même qui permet à l’apprentissage par renforcement de fonctionner sur des tâches de raisonnement.
Une idée née chez Google
Toutefois, le concept de chaîne de pensée ne vient pas de Jakub Pachocki, ni d’OpenAI d’ailleurs. Il est formalisé en 2022 par des chercheurs de Google, qui cherchent alors à comprendre « comment la génération d’une chaîne de pensée (une série d’étapes de raisonnement intermédiaires) améliore significativement la capacité des grands modèles de langage à effectuer des raisonnements complexes. »
Car jusque-là, un grand modèle de langage (LLM) fonctionne, pour simplifier, uniquement comme un système qui prédit le mot suivant le plus probable. Efficace pour des tâches simples, cette approche perd indéniablement en qualité sur des problèmes qui demandent plusieurs étapes de raisonnement : un calcul à plusieurs inconnues, un bug de code à tracer, une démonstration logique. Le modèle a alors tendance à « sauter » à une conclusion, parfois fausse, faute d’avoir décomposé le problème.
Le chain of thought (« chaîne de pensée ») consiste à forcer le modèle à dérouler son raisonnement étape par étape, en langage naturel, avant de produire sa réponse finale. Cette suite de phrases intermédiaires, généralement invisible sert de mémoire de travail externe au modèle, qui peut s’appuyer sur ses propres étapes précédentes pour construire les suivantes.
Dans leur travail de recherche, les chercheurs de Google prouvent qu’il suffit de donner à un grand modèle quelques exemples de raisonnements détaillés dans son prompt pour améliorer ses performances sur des tâches de logique, d’arithmétique ou de sens commun.
De la ruse de prompt à la capacité native
Dans un premier temps, le CoT repose donc sur une incitation via le prompt : on pousse le modèle, de l’extérieur, à simuler un raisonnement.
Mais en septembre 2024, le lancement d’o1 par OpenAI change la donne. Pour la première fois, un modèle est entraîné par apprentissage par renforcement à produire lui-même de longues chaînes de raisonnement avant de répondre, sans qu’on ait besoin de le lui demander. Une capacité désormais intégrée au modèle plutôt que provoquée par la formulation de la question.
OpenAI fait alors le choix de cacher cette chaîne de pensée brute aux utilisateurs, pour la protéger de toute pression de supervision externe. Mais en juillet 2025, le chain of thought devient un enjeu de sécurité à part entière.
Des chercheurs de l’ensemble de l’industrie, OpenAI compris, publient un article qui formalise l’idée que, parce que les modèles de raisonnement « pensent » en langage humain, il devient possible de lire leurs chaînes de pensée pour y détecter une intention de mal agir avant que l’action ne soit commise.
Un document qui pose les bases de ce qu’on appelle la « surveillance du chain of thought » : des systèmes automatisés qui lisent en continu le raisonnement des modèles pour repérer des signaux de triche, de manipulation ou de contournement des règles.
Concrètement, ce sont les équipes de sécurité et d’alignement internes aux laboratoires qui exploitent ces traces au quotidien, complétées par des auditeurs externes, mandatés notamment pour évaluer si un modèle « triche » sur des tests, dissimule ses véritables intentions ou sabote discrètement une tâche.
L’IA agentique et la fenêtre qui se referme
Mais voilà, An Alien Mind n’est pas un simple texte de souvenirs. Jakub Pachocki y explique aussi que cette fenêtre de surveillance se referme à mesure que l’IA agentique, ces systèmes capables d’agir de façon autonome sur plusieurs étapes, d’utiliser des outils, d’interagir avec d’autres IA, devient la norme plutôt que l’exception.
Le chercheur identifie trois raisons à cette dégradation. D’abord, les modèles de raisonnement actuels opèrent dans des environnements bien plus complexes qu’à l’époque d’o1. Leur raisonnement se mélange désormais à des échanges avec des humains, d’autres IA, et à l’utilisation d’outils, ce qui brouille la frontière entre ce qui peut être supervisé sans risque et ce qui ne le peut pas.
Ensuite, les modèles deviennent meilleurs pour raisonner sur leur propre processus de raisonnement, et donc, potentiellement, pour le manipuler. Enfin, l’amélioration du pré-entraînement fait qu’une partie croissante de l’intelligence des modèles s’exprime désormais sans passer du tout par un raisonnement verbalisé, échappant de fait à toute lecture.
Dans son papier, Jakub Pachocki affirme qu’aucun laboratoire, le sien y compris, n’a résolu l’alignement et la surveillance à un niveau suffisant pour continuer à accélérer indéfiniment en toute responsabilité. Raison pour laquelle il appelle à des ralentissements volontaires ainsi qu’à une coordination internationale sur le développement futur de l’IA.
Le scientifique évoque toutefois des pistes pour ne pas tout miser sur cette seule méthode. OpenAI expérimente actuellement une méthode complémentaire, baptisée « confessions ». Le principe : après avoir répondu à l’utilisateur, le modèle produit une seconde réponse, distincte, dans laquelle il est invité à revenir sur sa propre copie. A-t-il pris des raccourcis ? A-t-il enfreint une consigne ? A-t-il triché pour obtenir une meilleure note ?
L’idée est que ce mécanisme de contrôle interne soit plus difficile à berner que la réponse principale elle-même, car le modèle n’a aucun intérêt à mentir une seconde fois sur ses propres manquements. Testée sur GPT-5 Thinking, cette approche reste pour l’instant un prototype de recherche.
